		var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:hire_the_hashashin
		var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:excommunication_for_hire
		var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:dispensation_for_gold
		var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:steer_the_holy_war
		var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:purchase_a_mitre
		var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:bought_claim
		var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:holy_warrant
		var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:buy_a_bull
		var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:conclave_votes
		var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:fatwa_for_hire
		var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:fund_the_dawa
		var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:favourable_omens
		var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:temple_patronage
	}
}

qpq_ui_kind_needs_title_target_trigger = {
	OR = {
		var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:holy_sponsorship
		var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:development_charter
		var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:renunciation
		var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:title_swap
		var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:shelter_the_pretender
		var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:secret_clause
	}
}

qpq_ui_kind_needs_artifact_target_trigger = {
	OR = {
		var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:hand_over_artifact
	}
}

qpq_proposed_kind_is_agent_init_trigger = {
	OR = {
		scope:qpq_proposed_kind ?= flag:price_of_loyalty
		scope:qpq_proposed_kind ?= flag:electoral_capitulation
	}
}

qpq_ui_ask_valid_trigger = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:holy_sponsorship }
		custom_description = {
			text = qpq_valid_agent_same_faith
			NOT = { has_variable = qpq_ui_fail_0 }
		}
	}
	trigger_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:marriage_by_command }
		custom_description = {
			text = qpq_valid_can_marry
			NOT = { has_variable = qpq_ui_fail_0 }
		}
	}
	always = yes
}

qpq_ui_kind_still_possible_trigger = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:chartered_conquest }
		scope:recipient = {
			liege ?= scope:actor
			is_landed = yes
		}
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:sanctioned_conquest }
		scope:recipient = {
			liege ?= scope:actor
			is_landed = yes
		}
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:marcher_charge }
		scope:recipient = {
			liege ?= scope:actor
			is_landed = yes
		}
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:holy_sponsorship }
		scope:recipient = {
			liege ?= scope:actor
			is_landed = yes
		}
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:development_charter }
		scope:recipient = {
			liege ?= scope:actor
			is_landed = yes
		}
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:electoral_purchase }
		scope:recipient = {
			liege ?= scope:actor
			is_landed = yes
		}

		exists = scope:actor.primary_title
		scope:actor.primary_title = { any_elector = { this = scope:recipient } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:loyal_mole }
		scope:recipient = {
			liege ?= scope:actor
			is_landed = yes
		}
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:agent_provocateur }
		scope:recipient = {
			liege ?= scope:actor
			is_landed = yes
		}
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:licensed_feud }
		scope:recipient = {
			liege ?= scope:actor
			is_landed = yes
		}
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:dossier }
		scope:recipient = {
			OR = {
				liege ?= scope:actor
				is_courtier_of = scope:actor
			}
			is_adult = yes
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
		}
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:quiet_removal }
		scope:recipient = {
			OR = {
				liege ?= scope:actor
				is_courtier_of = scope:actor
			}
			is_adult = yes
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
		}
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:heir_question }
		scope:recipient = {
			OR = {
				liege ?= scope:actor
				is_courtier_of = scope:actor
			}
			is_adult = yes
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
		}
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:snatch }
		scope:recipient = {
			OR = {
				liege ?= scope:actor
				is_courtier_of = scope:actor
			}
			is_adult = yes
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
		}
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:dispossession }
		scope:recipient = {
			liege ?= scope:actor
			is_landed = yes
		}
		scope:recipient = { any_vassal = { is_landed = yes } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:the_cloister }
		scope:recipient = {
			liege ?= scope:actor
			is_landed = yes
		}
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:marriage_by_command }
		scope:recipient = {
			liege ?= scope:actor
			is_landed = yes
		}
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:hand_over }
		scope:recipient = {
			liege ?= scope:actor
			is_landed = yes
		}
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:hand_over_artifact }
		scope:recipient = {
			liege ?= scope:actor
			is_landed = yes
		}
		scope:recipient = { any_character_artifact = { always = yes } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:renunciation }
		scope:recipient = {
			liege ?= scope:actor
			is_landed = yes
		}
		scope:recipient = { any_claim = { always = yes } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:hush_money }
		scope:recipient = { NOT = { this = scope:actor } }
		scope:actor = {
			any_secret = { is_known_by = scope:recipient }
		}
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:price_of_loyalty }
		scope:actor = {
			liege ?= scope:recipient
			is_landed = yes
		}
		scope:recipient = { is_at_war = yes }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:blessing_for_a_feud }
		scope:actor = {
			liege ?= scope:recipient
			is_landed = yes
		}
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:clemency_bargain }
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				liege ?= scope:recipient
				is_imprisoned_by = scope:recipient
			}
			any_known_secret = {
				NOT = { secret_owner = scope:actor }
				NOT = { secret_owner = scope:recipient }
				NOT = { is_known_by = scope:recipient }
			}
		}
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:electoral_capitulation }
		exists = scope:recipient.primary_title
		scope:recipient.primary_title = { any_elector = { this = scope:actor } }
		NOT = { scope:actor = scope:recipient }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:mutual_defense_league }
		scope:actor = { is_landed = yes }
		scope:recipient = {
			is_landed = yes
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
		}
		exists = scope:actor.liege
		scope:actor.liege = scope:recipient.liege
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:faction_pledge }
		scope:actor = { is_landed = yes }
		scope:recipient = {
			is_landed = yes
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
		}
		exists = scope:actor.liege
		scope:actor.liege = scope:recipient.liege
		scope:actor = { exists = joined_faction joined_faction = { faction_target = scope:actor.liege } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:title_swap }
		scope:actor = { is_landed = yes }
		scope:recipient = {
			is_landed = yes
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
		}
		exists = scope:actor.liege
		scope:actor.liege = scope:recipient.liege
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:coup_pact }
		exists = scope:actor.liege
		scope:recipient = {
			is_adult = yes
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			NOT = { this = scope:actor.liege }
			OR = {
				is_courtier_of = scope:actor.liege
				is_courtier_of = scope:actor
			}
		}
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:proxy_war }
		NOT = { scope:recipient.top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }

		scope:actor = { is_landed = yes }
		scope:recipient = {
			is_independent_ruler = yes
			is_landed = yes
		}
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:partition_pact }
		NOT = { scope:recipient.top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }

		scope:actor = { is_landed = yes }
		scope:recipient = {
			is_independent_ruler = yes
			is_landed = yes
		}
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:secret_alliance }
		NOT = { scope:recipient.top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }
		scope:actor = { is_landed = yes } scope:recipient = { is_landed = yes }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:bought_truce }
		NOT = { scope:recipient.top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }
		scope:actor = { is_landed = yes } scope:recipient = { is_landed = yes }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:faithless_ally }
		NOT = { scope:recipient.top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }

		scope:actor = { is_landed = yes }
		scope:recipient = {
			is_independent_ruler = yes
			is_landed = yes
		}
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:turncoat }
		NOT = { scope:recipient.top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }

		scope:recipient = {
			exists = liege
			is_independent_ruler = no
		}
		scope:actor = { is_at_war_with = scope:recipient.liege }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:seed_the_separatists }
		NOT = { scope:recipient.top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }

		scope:actor = { is_landed = yes }
		scope:recipient = {
			is_landed = yes
			is_independent_ruler = no
			exists = liege
		}
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:shelter_the_pretender }
		scope:recipient = {
			is_adult = yes
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			any_claim = { tier >= tier_duchy NOT = { holder ?= scope:actor } }
		}
		scope:actor = { is_landed = yes }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:extradition }
		NOT = { scope:recipient.top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }

		scope:actor = { is_landed = yes }
		scope:recipient = {
			is_independent_ruler = yes
			is_landed = yes
		}
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:buy_a_councillor }
		NOT = { scope:recipient.top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }

		scope:recipient = {
			is_councillor = yes
			exists = liege
			is_councillor_of = scope:recipient.liege
		}
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:stay_home }
		NOT = { scope:recipient.top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }

		scope:actor = { is_landed = yes }
		scope:recipient = {
			is_landed = yes
			is_independent_ruler = no
			exists = liege
		}
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:defection_pact }
		NOT = { scope:recipient.top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }

		scope:actor = { is_landed = yes }
		scope:recipient = {
			is_landed = yes
			is_independent_ruler = no
			exists = liege
		}
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:secret_clause }
		NOT = { scope:recipient.top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }

		exists = scope:actor.house
		scope:recipient = {
			is_landed = yes
			OR = {
				any_spouse = { house ?= scope:actor.house }
				any_close_family_member = {
					OR = {
						any_spouse = { house ?= scope:actor.house }
						betrothed.house ?= scope:actor.house
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:hire_the_hashashin }
		NOT = { scope:recipient.top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }
		scope:recipient = {
			any_held_title = { is_holy_order = yes }
		}
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:excommunication_for_hire }
		scope:recipient = {
			qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
		}
		scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith
		scope:recipient.faith = { qpq_faith_has_church_trigger = yes }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:dispensation_for_gold }
		scope:recipient = {
			qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
		}
		scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith

		scope:recipient.faith = {
			OR = {
				qpq_faith_has_church_trigger = yes
				has_doctrine = doctrine_divorce_approval
			}
		}
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:steer_the_holy_war }
		scope:recipient = {
			qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
		}
		scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith
		scope:recipient.faith = { suitable_faith_for_any_ghw_trigger = yes }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:purchase_a_mitre }
		scope:recipient = {
			qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
		}
		scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith
		scope:recipient.faith = { qpq_faith_has_church_trigger = yes }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:bought_claim }
		scope:recipient = {
			qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
		}
		scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith
		scope:recipient.faith = { has_doctrine = doctrine_spiritual_head }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:absolution_by_concession }
		scope:recipient = {
			qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
		}
		scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith
		scope:actor = { has_trait = excommunicated } scope:recipient.faith = { qpq_faith_has_church_trigger = yes }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:holy_warrant }
		scope:recipient = {
			qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
		}
		scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith
		scope:recipient = { is_landed = yes highest_held_title_tier >= tier_county } scope:recipient.faith = { has_doctrine = doctrine_temporal_head }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:buy_a_bull }
		scope:recipient = {
			qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
		}
		scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith

		scope:recipient.faith = { has_doctrine_parameter = has_clerical_electors }
		has_dlc_feature = by_god_alone
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:conclave_votes }
		scope:recipient = {
			exists = clerical_elector_title
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
		}
		scope:recipient.faith = { has_doctrine_parameter = has_clerical_electors }
		has_dlc_feature = by_god_alone
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:council_lobbying }
		scope:recipient = {
			is_clergy = yes
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
		}
		scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith
		scope:recipient.faith = { has_doctrine_parameter = has_clerical_electors }
		has_dlc_feature = by_god_alone
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:caliphal_investiture }
		scope:recipient = {
			qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
		}
		scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith
		scope:recipient.faith = { has_doctrine = muhammad_succession_sunni_doctrine }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:name_in_the_khutba }
		NOT = { scope:recipient.top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }

		scope:actor = { is_landed = yes }
		scope:recipient = {
			is_landed = yes
			is_independent_ruler = no
			exists = liege
		}

		scope:actor.religion = religion:islam_religion
		scope:recipient.religion = religion:islam_religion
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:fatwa_for_hire }
		scope:recipient = {
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			religion = religion:islam_religion
			OR = {
				qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
				AND = {
					is_clergy = yes
					learning >= 15
				}
			}
		}
		scope:actor.religion = religion:islam_religion
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:fund_the_dawa }
		scope:recipient = {
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			faith = scope:actor.faith
			OR = {
				qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
				AND = { is_clergy = yes learning >= 12 }
			}
		}
		scope:actor.faith = { has_doctrine = muhammad_succession_shia_doctrine }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:crowning_the_usurper }
		scope:recipient = {
			qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
		}
		scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith

		scope:recipient.faith = faith:orthodox
		scope:actor = {
			is_independent_ruler = no
			top_liege = { highest_held_title_tier >= tier_empire }
		}
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:pliant_patriarch }
		scope:recipient = {
			qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
		}
		scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith

		scope:recipient.faith = faith:orthodox
		scope:actor = { highest_held_title_tier >= tier_kingdom }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:favourable_omens }
		scope:recipient = {
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			faith = scope:actor.faith
			OR = {
				qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
				this = scope:actor.realm_priest
			}
		}
		scope:actor.religion = { is_in_family = rf_pagan }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:consecration_rites }
		scope:recipient = {
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			faith = scope:actor.faith
			OR = {
				qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
				this = scope:actor.realm_priest
			}
		}
		scope:actor.religion = { is_in_family = rf_eastern }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:temple_patronage }
		scope:recipient = {
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			faith = scope:actor.faith
			OR = {
				is_clergy = yes
				government_has_flag = government_is_theocracy
			}
		}
		NOT = { exists = scope:actor.faith.religious_head }
	}
	trigger_else = {
		always = no
	}
}

qpq_ui_no_same_pact_trigger = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:chartered_conquest }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = chartered_conquest } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:sanctioned_conquest }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = sanctioned_conquest } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:marcher_charge }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = marcher_charge } }
	}

qpq_proposed_kind_still_valid_trigger = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:chartered_conquest }
		scope:recipient = {
			liege ?= scope:actor
			is_landed = yes
		}
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
		scope:secondary_recipient = { is_alive = yes }
		scope:secondary_recipient = {
			is_landed = yes
			NOT = { top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }
		}
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = chartered_conquest } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:sanctioned_conquest }
		scope:recipient = {
			liege ?= scope:actor
			is_landed = yes
		}
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
		scope:secondary_recipient = { is_alive = yes }
		scope:secondary_recipient = {
			is_landed = yes
			NOT = { top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }
		}
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = sanctioned_conquest } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:marcher_charge }
		scope:recipient = {
			liege ?= scope:actor
			is_landed = yes
		}
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
		scope:secondary_recipient = { is_alive = yes }
		scope:secondary_recipient = { is_landed = yes NOT = { top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege } }
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = marcher_charge } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:holy_sponsorship }
		scope:recipient = {
			liege ?= scope:actor
			is_landed = yes
		}
		exists = scope:target
		scope:target = { NOT = { faith = scope:actor.faith } }
		custom_description = {
			text = qpq_valid_agent_same_faith
			scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith
		}
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = holy_sponsorship } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:development_charter }
		scope:recipient = {
			liege ?= scope:actor
			is_landed = yes
		}
		exists = scope:target
		scope:target = { tier = tier_county }
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = development_charter } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:electoral_purchase }
		scope:recipient = {
			liege ?= scope:actor
			is_landed = yes
		}

		exists = scope:actor.primary_title
		scope:actor.primary_title = { any_elector = { this = scope:recipient } }
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
		scope:secondary_recipient = { is_alive = yes }
		scope:secondary_recipient = { NOT = { this = scope:recipient } }
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = electoral_purchase } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:loyal_mole }
		scope:recipient = {
			liege ?= scope:actor
			is_landed = yes
		}
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = loyal_mole } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:agent_provocateur }
		scope:recipient = {
			liege ?= scope:actor
			is_landed = yes
		}
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = agent_provocateur } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:licensed_feud }
		scope:recipient = {
			liege ?= scope:actor
			is_landed = yes
		}
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
		scope:secondary_recipient = { is_alive = yes }
		scope:secondary_recipient = { liege ?= scope:actor is_landed = yes }
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = licensed_feud } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:dossier }
		scope:recipient = {
			OR = {
				liege ?= scope:actor
				is_courtier_of = scope:actor
			}
			is_adult = yes
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
		}
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
		scope:secondary_recipient = { is_alive = yes }
		scope:secondary_recipient = { NOT = { this = scope:actor } }
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = dossier } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:quiet_removal }
		scope:recipient = {
			OR = {
				liege ?= scope:actor
				is_courtier_of = scope:actor
			}
			is_adult = yes
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
		}
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
		scope:secondary_recipient = { is_alive = yes }
		scope:secondary_recipient = {
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
			NOT = { is_child_of = scope:actor }
		}
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = quiet_removal } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:heir_question }
		scope:recipient = {
			OR = {
				liege ?= scope:actor
				is_courtier_of = scope:actor
			}
			is_adult = yes
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
		}
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
		scope:secondary_recipient = { is_alive = yes }
		scope:secondary_recipient = { NOT = { this = scope:recipient } }
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = heir_question } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:snatch }
		scope:recipient = {
			OR = {
				liege ?= scope:actor
				is_courtier_of = scope:actor
			}
			is_adult = yes
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
		}
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
		scope:secondary_recipient = { is_alive = yes }
		scope:secondary_recipient = { NOT = { this = scope:actor } NOT = { this = scope:recipient } }
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = snatch } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:dispossession }
		scope:recipient = {
			liege ?= scope:actor
			is_landed = yes
		}
		scope:recipient = { any_vassal = { is_landed = yes } }
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
		scope:secondary_recipient = { is_alive = yes }
		scope:secondary_recipient = { liege ?= scope:recipient }
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = dispossession } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:the_cloister }
		scope:recipient = {
			liege ?= scope:actor
			is_landed = yes
		}
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
		scope:secondary_recipient = { is_alive = yes }

			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
		}
		scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith

		scope:recipient.faith = { has_doctrine_parameter = has_clerical_electors }
		has_dlc_feature = by_god_alone
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
		scope:secondary_recipient = { is_alive = yes }
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = buy_a_bull } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:conclave_votes }
		scope:recipient = {
			exists = clerical_elector_title
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
		}
		scope:recipient.faith = { has_doctrine_parameter = has_clerical_electors }
		has_dlc_feature = by_god_alone
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
		scope:secondary_recipient = { is_alive = yes }
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = conclave_votes } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:council_lobbying }
		scope:recipient = {
			is_clergy = yes
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
		}
		scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith
		scope:recipient.faith = { has_doctrine_parameter = has_clerical_electors }
		has_dlc_feature = by_god_alone
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = council_lobbying } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:caliphal_investiture }
		scope:recipient = {
			qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
		}
		scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith
		scope:recipient.faith = { has_doctrine = muhammad_succession_sunni_doctrine }
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = caliphal_investiture } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:name_in_the_khutba }
		NOT = { scope:recipient.top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }

		scope:actor = { is_landed = yes }
		scope:recipient = {
			is_landed = yes
			is_independent_ruler = no
			exists = liege
		}

		scope:actor.religion = religion:islam_religion
		scope:recipient.religion = religion:islam_religion
		exists = scope:recipient.liege
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = name_in_the_khutba } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:fatwa_for_hire }
		scope:recipient = {
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			religion = religion:islam_religion
			OR = {
				qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
				AND = {
					is_clergy = yes
					learning >= 15
				}
			}
		}
		scope:actor.religion = religion:islam_religion
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
		scope:secondary_recipient = { is_alive = yes }
		scope:secondary_recipient = { is_landed = yes religion = religion:islam_religion }
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = fatwa_for_hire } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:fund_the_dawa }
		scope:recipient = {
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			faith = scope:actor.faith
			OR = {
				qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
				AND = { is_clergy = yes learning >= 12 }
			}
		}
		scope:actor.faith = { has_doctrine = muhammad_succession_shia_doctrine }
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
		scope:secondary_recipient = { is_alive = yes }
		scope:secondary_recipient = { is_landed = yes NOT = { faith = scope:actor.faith } }
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = fund_the_dawa } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:crowning_the_usurper }
		scope:recipient = {
			qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
		}
		scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith

		scope:recipient.faith = faith:orthodox
		scope:actor = {
			is_independent_ruler = no
			top_liege = { highest_held_title_tier >= tier_empire }
		}
		exists = scope:actor.top_liege
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = crowning_the_usurper } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:pliant_patriarch }
		scope:recipient = {
			qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
		}
		scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith

		scope:recipient.faith = faith:orthodox
		scope:actor = { highest_held_title_tier >= tier_kingdom }
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = pliant_patriarch } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:favourable_omens }
		scope:recipient = {
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			faith = scope:actor.faith
			OR = {
				qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
				this = scope:actor.realm_priest
			}
		}
		scope:actor.religion = { is_in_family = rf_pagan }
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
		scope:secondary_recipient = { is_alive = yes }
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = favourable_omens } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:consecration_rites }
		scope:recipient = {
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			faith = scope:actor.faith
			OR = {
				qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
				this = scope:actor.realm_priest
			}
		}
		scope:actor.religion = { is_in_family = rf_eastern }
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = consecration_rites } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:temple_patronage }
		scope:recipient = {
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			faith = scope:actor.faith
			OR = {
				is_clergy = yes
				government_has_flag = government_is_theocracy
			}
		}
		NOT = { exists = scope:actor.faith.religious_head }
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
		scope:secondary_recipient = { is_alive = yes }
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = temple_patronage } }
	}
	trigger_else = {
		always = no
	}
}

qpq_ui_offers_still_possible_trigger = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_o_gold
			qpq_ui_kind_allows_offer_gold_trigger = yes
		}
		trigger_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_agent_init }
			always = yes
		}
		trigger_else = {
			always = yes
		}
	}
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_o_land
			qpq_ui_kind_allows_offer_land_trigger = yes
		}
		trigger_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_agent_init }
			scope:recipient = { any_held_title = { tier = tier_county count >= 2 } }
		}
		trigger_else = {
			scope:actor = { any_held_title = { tier = tier_county count >= 2 } }
		}
	}
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_o_claim
			qpq_ui_kind_allows_offer_claim_trigger = yes
		}
		trigger_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_agent_init }
			scope:recipient = { is_landed = yes }
		}
		trigger_else = {
			scope:actor = { is_landed = yes }
		}
	}
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_o_office
			qpq_ui_kind_allows_offer_office_trigger = yes
		}
		trigger_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_agent_init }
			scope:recipient = { is_landed = yes }
			scope:actor = {
				OR = {
					liege ?= scope:recipient
					is_courtier_of = scope:recipient
				}
				NOT = { is_councillor_of = scope:recipient }
			}
		}
		trigger_else = {
			scope:actor = { is_landed = yes }
			scope:recipient = {
				OR = {
					liege ?= scope:actor
					is_courtier_of = scope:actor
				}
				NOT = { is_councillor_of = scope:actor }
			}
		}
	}
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_o_marriage
			qpq_ui_kind_allows_offer_marriage_trigger = yes
		}
		trigger_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_agent_init }
			scope:recipient = { any_close_family_member = { is_married = no NOT = { exists = betrothed } is_alive = yes } }
		}
		trigger_else = {
			scope:actor = { any_close_family_member = { is_married = no NOT = { exists = betrothed } is_alive = yes } }
		}
	}
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_o_release_hook
			qpq_ui_kind_allows_offer_release_hook_trigger = yes
		}
		trigger_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_agent_init }
			scope:recipient = { has_hook = scope:actor }
		}
		trigger_else = {
			scope:actor = { has_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
	}
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_o_my_word
			qpq_ui_kind_allows_offer_my_word_trigger = yes
		}
		trigger_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_agent_init }
			always = yes
		}
		trigger_else = {
			always = yes
		}
	}
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_o_secret
			qpq_ui_kind_allows_offer_secret_trigger = yes
		}
		trigger_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_agent_init }
			scope:recipient = {
				any_known_secret = {
					NOT = { secret_owner = scope:actor }
					NOT = { is_known_by = scope:actor }
				}
			}
		}
		trigger_else = {
			scope:actor = {
				any_known_secret = {
					NOT = { secret_owner = scope:recipient }
					NOT = { is_known_by = scope:recipient }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_o_contract
			qpq_ui_kind_allows_offer_contract_trigger = yes
		}
		trigger_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_agent_init }
			scope:actor = { liege ?= scope:recipient }
		}
		trigger_else = {
			scope:recipient = { liege ?= scope:actor }
		}
	}
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_o_succession
			qpq_ui_kind_allows_offer_succession_trigger = yes
		}
		trigger_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_agent_init }
			scope:actor = { is_child_of = scope:recipient } NOT = { scope:recipient.primary_heir ?= scope:actor }
		}
		trigger_else = {
			scope:recipient = { is_child_of = scope:actor } NOT = { scope:actor.primary_heir ?= scope:recipient }
		}
	}
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_o_clemency
			qpq_ui_kind_allows_offer_clemency_trigger = yes
		}
		trigger_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_agent_init }
			OR = {
				scope:actor = { is_imprisoned_by = scope:recipient }
				scope:recipient = { any_prisoner = { is_close_family_of = scope:actor } }
				scope:recipient = { has_opinion_modifier = { target = scope:actor modifier = qpq_criminal_pact_opinion } }
			}
		}
		trigger_else = {
			OR = {
				scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned_by = scope:actor }
				scope:actor = { any_prisoner = { is_close_family_of = scope:recipient } }
				scope:actor = { has_opinion_modifier = { target = scope:recipient modifier = qpq_criminal_pact_opinion } }
			}
		}
	}
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_o_arms
			qpq_ui_kind_allows_offer_arms_trigger = yes
		}
		trigger_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_agent_init }
			scope:recipient = { is_landed = yes }
		}
		trigger_else = {
			scope:actor = { is_landed = yes }
		}
	}
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_o_artifact
			qpq_ui_kind_allows_offer_artifact_trigger = yes
		}
		trigger_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_agent_init }
			scope:recipient = { any_character_artifact = { always = yes } }
		}
		trigger_else = {
			scope:actor = { any_character_artifact = { always = yes } }
		}
	}
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_o_church
			qpq_ui_kind_allows_offer_church_trigger = yes
		}
		trigger_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_agent_init }
			scope:recipient = { qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes faith = { qpq_faith_has_church_trigger = yes } }
		}
		trigger_else = {
			scope:actor = { qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes faith = { qpq_faith_has_church_trigger = yes } }
		}
	}
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_o_restraint
			qpq_ui_kind_allows_offer_restraint_trigger = yes
		}
		trigger_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_agent_init }
			scope:actor = { liege ?= scope:recipient }
		}
		trigger_else = {
			scope:recipient = { liege ?= scope:actor }
		}
	}
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_o_hook
			qpq_ui_kind_allows_offer_hook_trigger = yes
		}
		trigger_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_agent_init }
			scope:recipient = { has_usable_hook = scope:actor }
		}
		trigger_else = {
			scope:actor = { has_usable_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
	}
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_o_charter
			qpq_ui_kind_allows_offer_charter_trigger = yes
		}
		var:qpq_ui_payer_tier <= 0
		var:qpq_ui_agent_tier <= 0
	}
	always = yes
}
